text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream (region=us-west)
alex: ack. i'm on it. seeing p99 ~4.2s, p95 ~750ms. streaming stalls observed.
alex: @maria can you pull up the SLO dashboard? we might be approaching SLO breach.
maria: pulling now. p95 = 720ms -> 750ms, p99 jumped from 1.1s -> 4.2s in last 8m. error rate low but tail latency is high.
alex: initial hypothesis: excessive backend paging due to cache miss storm. sam any recent deploys to prefix/hash logic?
sam: yes pushed prefix-salting change 12m ago to reduce collisions. rollout was gradual but reached ~60% traffic.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2967999800 -> 2968000100 (sam) applied to runtime-service: prefix-salt v2. Rollout %: 60% :white_check_mark:
alex: that aligns. if salt changed, prefix cache keys won't match -> low hit rate -> more paging -> tail latency.
alex: can we confirm cache hit rate delta?
sam: pulling metrics... here's a quick query:
```
# prometheus-ish pseudo
rate(prefix_cache_hits_total[5m]) / rate(prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])
```
sam: results: global hit rate dropped from 92% -> 18% in ~10m window. prefix miss rate spiked accordingly.
maria: logs show massive kvfetch calls per request and increased paging for long sequences. sample trace:
```
TRACE 2026-03-15T18:20:10Z request_id=abc123 step=kv_fetch latency=1800ms
TRACE 2026-03-15T18:20:10Z request_id=abc123 step=generate latency=2100ms
```
alex: wow. that explains p99. what's the current customer impact? any errors or K customer tickets?
jin: product here. observed increased timeouts for a few high-throughput customers. no widespread 5xx yet. customers with streaming UX see stalls and frozen progress bars. potential SLO breach for a couple enterprise contracts if p99 > SLA for > 30m.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) roll back prefix-salt rollout to v1 on affected pool(s) 2) enable temporary caching bypass throttle to limit KV reads 3) notify impacted customers and SRE oncall handoff.
sam: ready to roll back. rollback command (runtime deployment):
```
# rollback hint
kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/serve-runtime runtime=image:prefix-salt-v1 --record
```
sam: starting rollback on us-west pool now. will patch traffic weight back to previously stable config.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: 2968000245 by sam. Target: runtime-service us-west. Rolling back to prefix-salt v1.
alex: monitoring hit rate and latencies.
sam: hit rate recovering on primary pool: 18% -> 67% within 40s. paging calls dropping.
maria: p99 dropping: 4.2s -> 1.2s in last 90s. still above baseline but trending down.
alex: good. continue watching for 15m. sam, leave rollback in place until we validate full recovery and run canary on newer logic with synthetic load.
sam: will hold rollback. re-run the canary with simulated prefix salt variants in staging and compare.
jin: i'll draft a quick customer message for those enterprise tenants. need list of impacted customers and timing window.
maria: collecting impacted customers from request sampling. preliminary list: cust-a, cust-b (high throughput), cust-c (streaming UI). will attach request ids.
alex: handoff: i'm off shift in 20m. @maria you'll be the primary oncall for the next shift. summary for handoff:
- Incident: prefix-salt rollout caused dramatic cache miss spike -> paging -> p99 latency increase for /v1/stream
- Mitigation: rollback to prefix-salt v1 rolled back at 2968000245. hit rate recovering, p99 trending down.
- Action items: 1) run full canary of prefix-salt v2 in staging with synthetic workloads 2) validate cache key compatibility tests 3) prepare postmortem and customer timeline 4) coordinate with product on customer messaging
- Estimated impact window: 18:12:00 -> 18:26:00 UTC (approx)
maria: ack. i'll take it. i'll keep tracking, update the incident doc, and post a follow-up when p99 < 1s for 15m.
alex: thanks. one more: tag owners in postmortem - assigning sam for runtime change, maria for mitigation and metrics, jin for customer comms.
sam: noted. will prepare gists with prefix hashing tests and cluster-level rollout strategy.
jin: will prepare customer note draft and share in #customer-success for review.
alex: closing live incident channel in 10m if stable. please escalate if p99 creeps up.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation applied). Severity: Sev2. Handoff to oncall: maria. Timeline: root_ts=2968001234.
maria: creating incident doc now and linking to postmortem thread. :memo:
sam: quick follow-up: we should add automated integration tests that catch salt/key changes — adding to backlog.
jin: also run a customer impact calc for SLA exposure, I'll pull billing & SLA windows.
maria: handing off owner list: sam (runtime fix), jin (customer comms), alex (postmortem review), maria (metrics & longterm monitoring). will update slack thread when done.
alex: thanks everyone. good mitigation and quick rollback. :thumbsup:
